task.name: place_block_into_drawer
task.description: Use the right arm to place the yellow block inside the drawer, and then push the drawer closed.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the yellow block.
2. Grasp the yellow block with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the open drawer.
4. Release the gripper to place the yellow block inside the drawer.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the drawer handle.
6. Push the drawer closed using the right arm.
